problem:
Given the orthogonal basis $B$ of ${R}^{3}$ and the vector $x$ below, find the value of $5{x}_{3}$, where ${x}_{3}$ is the third component of $[x]_{B}.$

$$
B={[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2 \\ 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 2\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]},\,x=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -7 \\ 6\end{aligned}]
$$

activity_context.topic_title: The Components of a Vector with Respect to an Orthogonal or Orthonormal Basis
